Unlock Mate: Never Forget Why You Picked Up Your Phone

Boost your productivity and mindfulness by tracking every time you unlock your phone. Unlock Mate helps you remember exactly why you reached for your device, reducing distractions and keeping you focused on what truly matters.

Key Features:

Instant Reason Logging: Quickly note why you unlocked your phone with just a tap or voice command.

Voice Input: Use advanced speech recognition to log reasons hands-free and on-the-go.

Productivity Insights: Visualize your unlock patterns and reasons with intuitive charts.

Smart Reminders: Set custom alerts to stay on task and avoid unnecessary phone checks.

Lock Screen Widget: Log reasons directly from your home screen for seamless tracking.

 Habit Formation: Build better digital habits by understanding your unlock triggers.

 Dark Mode: Easy on the eyes for late-night productivity.

 Multiple Languages: Stay productive in your preferred language.

 Privacy-First: All your data stays securely on your device.

Ad-free experience for uninterrupted focus

Stop wondering where your time goes when you pick up your phone. With Unlock Mate, you'll always know why you unlocked your device, helping you stay on track and boost your productivity.

Download Unlock Mate now and transform every phone unlock into a mindful, productive moment!

quotes.text:
A little something I have been working on and wanted to share it here to see if it’s useful

Have You ever picked up your phone to do one thing and suddenly you’re , scrolling through social media, watching videos, or browsing random stuff. Two hours later, you can't even remember why you picked up your phone in the first place!

I tired to solve this problem by creating a lock screen widget that you see every time on your Lock Screen before picking up your phone, you can quickly tap the widget and enter the reason why you unlocked your phone.  This way you can choose to keep browsing your phone and be sure that you will not forget.  You also get a reminder 10 minutes later to ask you if you are done with the intended task.

Only on iOS https://apps.apple.com/de/app/unlock-mate-reminders/id6736634005?l=en-GB
